en-US.longDescription: Join all-time meetings anytime, anywhere, just by picking up your phone. All-time Cloud Meetings offer features such as phone and network voice, multi-party calls, text communication, desktop sharing, video sharing, and contact list. During the meeting, you can freely switch between phone and network voice, easily achieving multi-party communication and convening meetings conveniently anytime and anywhere
en-US.name: Quanshi Meeting
